# Province-country scope. var:oe_yp_unit from the tag (the setup block cannot set variables).
oe_yp_set_unit_by_tag = {
    if = { limit = { tag = YHN } set_variable = { name = oe_yp_unit value = 2 } }
    else_if = { limit = { tag = YJZ } set_variable = { name = oe_yp_unit value = 3 } }
    else_if = { limit = { tag = YJX } set_variable = { name = oe_yp_unit value = 4 } }
    else_if = { limit = { tag = YHG } set_variable = { name = oe_yp_unit value = 5 } }
    else_if = { limit = { tag = YSX } set_variable = { name = oe_yp_unit value = 6 } }
    else_if = { limit = { tag = YSC } set_variable = { name = oe_yp_unit value = 7 } }
    else_if = { limit = { tag = YLB } set_variable = { name = oe_yp_unit value = 8 } }
    else_if = { limit = { tag = YLY } set_variable = { name = oe_yp_unit value = 9 } }
    else_if = { limit = { tag = YGU } set_variable = { name = oe_yp_unit value = 10 } }
}

# Any scope, idempotent. For each branch secretariat that exists: unit variable and loyalty start value if missing;
# subject relation if the 12_ dependency did not load (vanilla make_subject_of, as trade-company buildings use it);
# the seat office if it is missing (instant, free). Records fallbacks in global var oe_yp_fallback_subject / _seat.
oe_yp_setup_countries = {
    if = { # 河南江北
        limit = { country_exists = c:YHN country_exists = c:CHI NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yp_end_u2 } }
        c:YHN = {
            if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_yp_unit } } oe_yp_set_unit_by_tag = yes }
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { is_subject_of = c:CHI } }
                make_subject_of = { target = c:CHI type = subject_type:oe_yp_xingsheng }
                set_global_variable = { name = oe_yp_fallback_subject value = 1 }
            }
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_yp_loyalty } }
                set_variable = { name = oe_yp_loyalty_target value = oe_yp_loyalty_target_value }
                set_variable = { name = oe_yp_loyalty value = var:oe_yp_loyalty_target }
            }
            save_scope_as = oe_yp_prov_YHN
        }
        location:tongxu = {
            if = {
                limit = { owner ?= c:CHI NOT = { has_building = building_type:oe_yp_xingsheng_seat } }
                construct_building = {
                    building_type = building_type:oe_yp_xingsheng_seat
                    owner = scope:oe_yp_prov_YHN
                    cost_multiplier = 0
                    cost_multiplier_reason = "game_concept_event"
                    instant = yes
                }
                set_global_variable = { name = oe_yp_fallback_seat value = 1 }
            }
        }
    }
    if = { # 江浙
        limit = { country_exists = c:YJZ country_exists = c:CHI NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yp_end_u3 } }
        c:YJZ = {

        limit = { country_exists = c:YJX country_exists = c:CHI NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yp_end_u4 } }

                make_subject_of = { target = c:CHI type = subject_type:oe_yp_xingsheng }
                set_global_variable = { name = oe_yp_fallback_subject value = 1 }
            }
            if = {

                set_variable = { name = oe_yp_loyalty_target value = oe_yp_loyalty_target_value }
                set_variable = { name = oe_yp_loyalty value = var:oe_yp_loyalty_target }
            }
            save_scope_as = oe_yp_prov_YJX
        }
        location:nanchang = {
            if = {
                limit = { owner ?= c:CHI NOT = { has_building = building_type:oe_yp_xingsheng_seat } }
                construct_building = {
                    building_type = building_type:oe_yp_xingsheng_seat
                    owner = scope:oe_yp_prov_YJX
                    cost_multiplier = 0
                    cost_multiplier_reason = "game_concept_event"
                    instant = yes

    if = { # 湖广
        limit = { country_exists = c:YHG country_exists = c:CHI NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yp_end_u5 } }

# Any scope. The 1337 governors rule their branch secretariat (the author's BYT01 start does the same for its governor:
# move_country, then set_new_ruler, only when the setup block did not already do it). Run once, after the lobby.
oe_yp_setup_rulers = {
    if = { # 江浙
        limit = { country_exists = c:YJZ exists = character:oe_yp_temur_buqa character:oe_yp_temur_buqa = { is_alive = yes } }
        character:oe_yp_temur_buqa = { if = { limit = { NOT = { owner ?= c:YJZ } } move_country = c:YJZ } }
        c:YJZ = { if = { limit = { NOT = { ruler ?= character:oe_yp_temur_buqa } } set_new_ruler = character:oe_yp_temur_buqa } }
    }
    if = { # 湖广
        limit = { country_exists = c:YHG exists = character:oe_yp_noqai character:oe_yp_noqai = { is_alive = yes } }
        character:oe_yp_noqai = { if = { limit = { NOT = { owner ?= c:YHG } } move_country = c:YHG } }
        c:YHG = { if = { limit = { NOT = { ruler ?= character:oe_yp_noqai } } set_new_ruler = character:oe_yp_noqai } }
    }
    if = { # 江西
        limit = { country_exists = c:YJX exists = character:oe_yp_shadi character:oe_yp_shadi = { is_alive = yes } }
        character:oe_yp_shadi = { if = { limit = { NOT = { owner ?= c:YJX } } move_country = c:YJX } }
        c:YJX = { if = { limit = { NOT = { ruler ?= character:oe_yp_shadi } } set_new_ruler = character:oe_yp_shadi } }
    }
    if = { # 河南江北
        limit = { country_exists = c:YHN exists = character:oe_yp_qingtong character:oe_yp_qingtong = { is_alive = yes } }
        character:oe_yp_qingtong = { if = { limit = { NOT = { owner ?= c:YHN } } move_country = c:YHN } }
        c:YHN = { if = { limit = { NOT = { ruler ?= character:oe_yp_qingtong } } set_new_ruler = character:oe_yp_qingtong } }
    }
}

# Branch-secretariat country scope (building or frontier), monthly. Loyalty moves 1 point a month toward
# oe_yp_loyalty_target_value and stops on the target (no 1-point oscillation around a fractional target).
# Round 6 C1 step 2: the loyalty tier (oe_yp_tier_value: 3 compliant, 2 normal, 1 slack, 0 estranged) puts location modifiers
# on the unit's land (oe_yp_apply_tier). They are rewritten when the tier changes and renewed every January while the tier is
# not normal; they last 13 months, so land that passes to another owner loses them within a year.
oe_yp_monthly = {
    oe_yp_monthly_loyalty = yes
    set_variable = { name = oe_yp_tier_new value = oe_yp_tier_value }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_yp_tier } var:oe_yp_tier_new = 2 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_yp_tier value = 2 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            OR = {
                NOT = { has_variable = oe_yp_tier }
                var:oe_yp_tier < var:oe_yp_tier_new
                var:oe_yp_tier > var:oe_yp_tier_new
                AND = { current_month = 1 NOT = { var:oe_yp_tier_new = 2 } }
            }
        }
        set_variable = { name = oe_yp_tier value = var:oe_yp_tier_new }
        oe_yp_apply_tier = yes
    }
}

# Branch-secretariat country scope. The loyalty step of oe_yp_monthly (as Y3 step 1). The target is read from the script
# value itself (oe_yp_loyalty_target is still written as before): event options reach this through
# oe_yp_change_loyalty, and their tooltip preview does not apply the set_variable just above (yuan-fix1, the r23 g5 pattern).
oe_yp_monthly_loyalty = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_yp_unit } } oe_yp_set_unit_by_tag = yes }
    set_variable = { name = oe_yp_loyalty_target value = oe_yp_loyalty_target_value }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_yp_loyalty } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_yp_loyalty value = oe_yp_loyalty_target_value }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { var:oe_yp_loyalty < oe_yp_loyalty_target_value }
        change_variable = { name = oe_yp_loyalty add = 1 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_yp_loyalty > oe_yp_loyalty_target_value } set_variable = { name = oe_yp_loyalty value = oe_yp_loyalty_target_value } }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { var:oe_yp_loyalty > oe_yp_loyalty_target_value }
        change_variable = { name = oe_yp_loyalty add = -1 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_yp_loyalty < oe_yp_loyalty_target_value } set_variable = { name = oe_yp_loyalty value = oe_yp_loyalty_target_value } }
    }
    clamp_variable = { name = oe_yp_loyalty min = 0 max = 100 }
}

# Any scope. Usage: oe_yp_change_loyalty = { unit = 4 amount = -10 } (Y4 events call it since round 6, LOYALTY_HOOK "y3").
# Changes the current loyalty of the branch secretariat of unit 2..10 (2 Henan Jiangbei 3 Jiangzhe 4 Jiangxi 5 Huguang
# 6 Shaanxi 7 Sichuan; round 6: 8 Lingbei 9 Liaoyang 10 Gansu) by amount, clamped to 0..100; it then drifts back toward the
# target by 1 point a month. Unit 1 (Fuli, under the Central Secretariat itself) has no branch secretariat: nothing happens.
# No tooltip: callers write their own.
oe_yp_change_loyalty = {
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:CHI }
        c:CHI = {
            every_subject = {
                limit = { OR = { is_subject_type = oe_yp_xingsheng is_subject_type = oe_yp_frontier } var:oe_yp_unit ?= $unit$ }
                if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_yp_loyalty } } oe_yp_monthly_loyalty = yes }
                change_variable = { name = oe_yp_loyalty add = $amount$ }
                clamp_variable = { name = oe_yp_loyalty min = 0 max = 100 }
            }
        }
    }
}

# Any scope. Round 6 C1. Usage: oe_yp_appoint_governor = { unit = 2 who = character:oe_yp_dorji }
# The character (alive) becomes the ruler of the branch secretariat of unit 2..10 (building or frontier): moved into that
# country if needed, then set_new_ruler (as the 1337 governors at the start, oe_yp_setup_rulers). The previous ruler, if alive,
# returns to the Yuan court (move_country = c:CHI). A character who already rules another branch secretariat (Dorji, moved
# from Liaoyang to Henan in 1340) leaves it to a new governor made there (create_character, the character's culture and
# religion, aged 35 to 55; vanilla change_ruler only takes characters who rule nothing). Nothing happens when the unit has
# no branch secretariat, the character already rules it, or the character rules any other country (the emperor, a prince).
# No tooltip: callers write their own.
oe_yp_appoint_governor = {
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_yp_gov_target } clear_saved_scope = oe_yp_gov_target }
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_yp_gov_old } clear_saved_scope = oe_yp_gov_old }
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_yp_gov_prev } clear_saved_scope = oe_yp_gov_prev }
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_yp_gov_new } clear_saved_scope = oe_yp_gov_new }
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_yp_gov_who } clear_saved_scope = oe_yp_gov_who }
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:CHI exists = $who$ $who$ = { is_alive = yes } }
        c:CHI = {
            random_subject = {
                limit = { OR = { is_subject_type = oe_yp_xingsheng is_subject_type = oe_yp_frontier } var:oe_yp_unit ?= $unit$ }
                save_scope_as = oe_yp_gov_target
            }
        }
        $who$ = {
            save_scope_as = oe_yp_gov_who
            if = { limit = { is_ruler = yes } owner ?= { save_scope_as = oe_yp_gov_prev } }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                exists = scope:oe_yp_gov_target
                NOT = { scope:oe_yp_gov_target = { ruler ?= $who$ } }
                OR = {
                    NOT = { exists = scope:oe_yp_gov_prev }
                    scope:oe_yp_gov_prev = {
                        is_subject_of = c:CHI
                        OR = { is_subject_type = oe_yp_xingsheng is_subject_type = oe_yp_frontier }
                    }
                }
            }
            scope:oe_yp_gov_target = { ruler ?= { save_scope_as = oe_yp_gov_old } }
            $who$ = { if = { limit = { NOT = { owner ?= scope:oe_yp_gov_target } } move_country = scope:oe_yp_gov_target } }
            scope:oe_yp_gov_target = {
                set_new_ruler = $who$
                set_variable = { name = oe_yp_gov_appointed value = 1 }
            }
            if = {
                limit = { exists = scope:oe_yp_gov_old scope:oe_yp_gov_old = { is_alive = yes NOT = { this = $who$ } } }
                scope:oe_yp_gov_old = { move_country = c:CHI }
            }
            if = {
                limit = { exists = scope:oe_yp_gov_prev }
                scope:oe_yp_gov_prev = {
                    create_character = {
                        culture = scope:oe_yp_gov_who.culture
                        religion = scope:oe_yp_gov_who.religion
                        age = { 35 55 }
                        female = no
                        trait_category = ruler
                        save_scope_as = oe_yp_gov_new
                    }
                    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_yp_gov_new } set_new_ruler = scope:oe_yp_gov_new }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
# Location scope; scope:oe_yp_tp is the branch secretariat. Clears the tier modifiers and puts the current tier's one.
oe_yp_tier_location = {
    if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_yp_tier_loyal } remove_location_modifier = oe_yp_tier_loyal }
    if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_yp_tier_lax } remove_location_modifier = oe_yp_tier_lax }
    if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_yp_tier_estranged } remove_location_modifier = oe_yp_tier_estranged }
    if = { limit = { scope:oe_yp_tp = { var:oe_yp_tier ?= 3 } } add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_yp_tier_loyal months = 13 mode = replace } }
    else_if = { limit = { scope:oe_yp_tp = { var:oe_yp_tier ?= 1 } } add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_yp_tier_lax months = 13 mode = replace } }
    else_if = { limit = { scope:oe_yp_tp = { var:oe_yp_tier ?= 0 } } add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_yp_tier_estranged months = 13 mode = replace } }
}

# Branch-secretariat country scope. Rewrites the tier modifiers on the unit's land: CHI's locations of the unit for the
# building-type secretariats (the land is the Yuan's), the frontier country's own locations for the frontier ones.
oe_yp_apply_tier = {
    save_scope_as = oe_yp_tp
    if = { limit = { var:oe_yp_unit ?= 2 } c:CHI ?= { every_owned_location = { limit = { var:oe_yp_unit ?= 2 } oe_yp_tier_location = yes } } } # 河南江北
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_yp_unit ?= 3 } c:CHI ?= { every_owned_location = { limit = { var:oe_yp_unit ?= 3 } oe_yp_tier_location = yes } } } # 江浙
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_yp_unit ?= 4 } c:CHI ?= { every_owned_location = { limit = { var:oe_yp_unit ?= 4 } oe_yp_tier_location = yes } } } # 江西
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_yp_unit ?= 5 } c:CHI ?= { every_owned_location = { limit = { var:oe_yp_unit ?= 5 } oe_yp_tier_location = yes } } } # 湖广
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_yp_unit ?= 6 } c:CHI ?= { every_owned_location = { limit = { var:oe_yp_unit ?= 6 } oe_yp_tier_location = yes } } } # 陕西
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_yp_unit ?= 7 } c:CHI ?= { every_owned_location = { limit = { var:oe_yp_unit ?= 7 } oe_yp_tier_location = yes } } } # 四川
    else_if = { limit = { is_subject_type = oe_yp_frontier } every_owned_location = { oe_yp_tier_location = yes } } # frontier
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- round 7 F6 (Y2): when the Yuan falls
# Design: work/plan_20261117/r7/f6-yuan.md. The monthly check is oe_yp_collapse_check (on_action oe_yp_collapse_pulse).

# Location scope. Removes the Y3 markers (var oe_yp_unit, oe_yp_seat) and the loyalty-tier modifiers from this location.
oe_yp_clear_location = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_yp_unit } remove_variable = oe_yp_unit }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_yp_seat } remove_variable = oe_yp_seat }
    if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_yp_tier_loyal } remove_location_modifier = oe_yp_tier_loyal }
    if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_yp_tier_lax } remove_location_modifier = oe_yp_tier_lax }
    if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_yp_tier_estranged } remove_location_modifier = oe_yp_tier_estranged }
}

    province_definition:chol_province = { every_location_in_province_definition = { oe_yp_clear_location = yes } }
    province_definition:lower_non_province = { every_location_in_province_definition = { oe_yp_clear_location = yes } }
    province_definition:nuomin_province = { every_location_in_province_definition = { oe_yp_clear_location = yes } }
    province_definition:taoer_province = { every_location_in_province_definition = { oe_yp_clear_location = yes } }
    province_definition:upper_non_province = { every_location_in_province_definition = { oe_yp_clear_location = yes } }
    province_definition:greater_ussuri_province = { every_location_in_province_definition = { oe_yp_clear_location = yes } }
    province_definition:muling_province = { every_location_in_province_definition = { oe_yp_clear_location = yes } }
    province_definition:smaller_ussuri_province = { every_location_in_province_definition = { oe_yp_clear_location = yes } }
    province_definition:sanjiang_province = { every_location_in_province_definition = { oe_yp_clear_location = yes } }
    province_definition:suifun_province = { every_location_in_province_definition = { oe_yp_clear_location = yes } }
    province_definition:tumen_province = { every_location_in_province_definition = { oe_yp_clear_location = yes } }
    province_definition:daning_province = { every_location_in_province_definition = { oe_yp_clear_location = yes } }
    province_definition:chaoyang_province = { every_location_in_province_definition = { oe_yp_clear_location = yes } }
}

# Any scope. Clears every location of unit 10 (Gansu: the 11 provinces of the CSV), whoever owns it now.
oe_yp_clear_unit_10 = {
    province_definition:alasha_province = { every_location_in_province_definition = { oe_yp_clear_location = yes } }
    province_definition:khara_khoto_province = { every_location_in_province_definition = { oe_yp_clear_location = yes } }
    province_definition:barkul_province = { every_location_in_province_definition = { oe_yp_clear_location = yes } }
    province_definition:ganzhou_gansu_province = { every_location_in_province_definition = { oe_yp_clear_location = yes } }
    province_definition:shazhou_province = { every_location_in_province_definition = { oe_yp_clear_location = yes } }
    province_definition:suzhou_gansu_province = { every_location_in_province_definition = { oe_yp_clear_location = yes } }
    province_definition:xining_province = { every_location_in_province_definition = { oe_yp_clear_location = yes } }
    province_definition:yongchang_gansu_province = { every_location_in_province_definition = { oe_yp_clear_location = yes } }
    province_definition:lingzhou_province = { every_location_in_province_definition = { oe_yp_clear_location = yes } }
    province_definition:ningxia_province = { every_location_in_province_definition = { oe_yp_clear_location = yes } }
    province_definition:hami_province = { every_location_in_province_definition = { oe_yp_clear_location = yes } }
}

# Any scope. Ends the building-type branch secretariat YHN (Henan Jiangbei): its overlord annexes it (as the author's
# theme abolition, annex_country with transfer), or, with no overlord, destroy_building_country; then the seat office
# at tongxu is removed (the country first, so the building never outlives it unannexed).
oe_yp_end_YHN = {
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_yp_end_lord_YHN } clear_saved_scope = oe_yp_end_lord_YHN }
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:YHN }
        c:YHN = {
            set_variable = oe_yp_ended
            if = { limit = { is_subject = yes } overlord = { save_scope_as = oe_yp_end_lord_YHN } }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { exists = scope:oe_yp_end_lord_YHN }
            scope:oe_yp_end_lord_YHN = { annex_country = { country = c:YHN reason = Diplomatic transfer = yes } }
        }
        else = { destroy_building_country = c:YHN }
    }
    location:tongxu = { if = { limit = { has_building = building_type:oe_yp_xingsheng_seat } destroy_all_buildings_of_type = building_type:oe_yp_xingsheng_seat } }
}

# Any scope. Usage: oe_yp_end_unit_2 = { reason = N } (codes in oe_yp.1). Ends unit 2 for good: global var
# oe_yp_end_u2 = reason, the secretariat YHN ends, the unit's locations lose their markers and tier modifiers.
oe_yp_end_unit_2 = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yp_end_u2 value = $reason$ }
    oe_yp_end_YHN = yes
    oe_yp_clear_unit_2 = yes
    debug_log = "oe_yp Y2: branch secretariat YHN (unit 2, Henan Jiangbei) ended"
}

# Any scope. Ends the frontier branch secretariat YLB (Lingbei). Its overlord annexes it, land and army (the Yuan;
# after vanilla red_turban_rebellions.101 the Northern Yuan YUA; after a peace that transferred it, the new overlord).
# With no overlord it stays an independent country, renamed to its region, without any Y3 variable or tier modifier.
oe_yp_end_YLB = {
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_yp_end_lord_YLB } clear_saved_scope = oe_yp_end_lord_YLB }
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:YLB }
        c:YLB = {
            set_variable = oe_yp_ended
            every_owned_location = { oe_yp_clear_location = yes }
            if = { limit = { is_subject = yes } overlord = { save_scope_as = oe_yp_end_lord_YLB } }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { exists = scope:oe_yp_end_lord_YLB }
            scope:oe_yp_end_lord_YLB = { annex_country = { country = c:YLB reason = Diplomatic transfer = yes } }
        }
        else = {
            c:YLB = {
                change_country_name = oe_yp_free_YLB
                if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_yp_unit } remove_variable = oe_yp_unit }
                if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_yp_loyalty } remove_variable = oe_yp_loyalty }
                if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_yp_loyalty_target } remove_variable = oe_yp_loyalty_target }
                if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_yp_tier } remove_variable = oe_yp_tier }
                if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_yp_tier_new } remove_variable = oe_yp_tier_new }
                if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_yp_gov_appointed } remove_variable = oe_yp_gov_appointed }
                if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_yp_ended } remove_variable = oe_yp_ended }
            }
        }
    }
}

# Any scope. Usage: oe_yp_end_unit_8 = { reason = N } (codes in oe_yp.1). Ends unit 8 for good: global var
# oe_yp_end_u8 = reason, the secretariat YLB ends, the unit's locations lose their markers and tier modifiers.

# Any scope. Usage: oe_yp_dissolve_all = { reason = oe_yp_fall_reason } (a number for tests; 9 = test button).
# The Yuan has fallen: every branch secretariat ends and the markers of all ten units are wiped; once per campaign
# (global var oe_yp_dissolved = reason, oe_yp_dissolved_year). The current scope's own secretariat, if any, ends last.
oe_yp_dissolve_all = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yp_dissolved value = $reason$ }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yp_dissolved_year value = current_year }
    debug_log = "oe_yp Y2: the Yuan has fallen, every branch secretariat is dissolved"
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yp_end_u2 } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yp_end_u2 value = 5 } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yp_end_u3 } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yp_end_u3 value = 5 } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yp_end_u4 } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yp_end_u4 value = 5 } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yp_end_u5 } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yp_end_u5 value = 5 } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yp_end_u6 } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yp_end_u6 value = 5 } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yp_end_u7 } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yp_end_u7 value = 5 } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yp_end_u8 } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yp_end_u8 value = 5 } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yp_end_u9 } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yp_end_u9 value = 5 } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yp_end_u10 } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yp_end_u10 value = 5 } }
    oe_yp_clear_unit_1 = yes
    oe_yp_clear_unit_2 = yes
    oe_yp_clear_unit_3 = yes
    oe_yp_clear_unit_4 = yes
    oe_yp_clear_unit_5 = yes
    oe_yp_clear_unit_6 = yes
    oe_yp_clear_unit_7 = yes
    oe_yp_clear_unit_8 = yes
    oe_yp_clear_unit_9 = yes
    oe_yp_clear_unit_10 = yes
    oe_y1_on_yuan_fall = yes # registered clean-up of another Yuan line
    oe_yw_on_yuan_fall = yes # registered clean-up of another Yuan line
    oe_y7_on_yuan_fall = yes # registered clean-up of another Yuan line
    oe_yc_on_yuan_fall = yes # registered clean-up of another Yuan line
    oe_yh_on_yuan_fall = yes # registered clean-up of another Yuan line
    oe_yr_on_yuan_fall = yes # registered clean-up of another Yuan line
    oe_yk_on_yuan_fall = yes # registered clean-up of another Yuan line
    if = { limit = { NOT = { AND = { country_exists = c:YHN c:YHN = { this = root } } } } oe_yp_end_YHN = yes }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { AND = { country_exists = c:YJZ c:YJZ = { this = root } } } } oe_yp_end_YJZ = yes }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { AND = { country_exists = c:YJX c:YJX = { this = root } } } } oe_yp_end_YJX = yes }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { AND = { country_exists = c:YHG c:YHG = { this = root } } } } oe_yp_end_YHG = yes }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { AND = { country_exists = c:YSX c:YSX = { this = root } } } } oe_yp_end_YSX = yes }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { AND = { country_exists = c:YSC c:YSC = { this = root } } } } oe_yp_end_YSC = yes }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { AND = { country_exists = c:YLB c:YLB = { this = root } } } } oe_yp_end_YLB = yes }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { AND = { country_exists = c:YLY c:YLY = { this = root } } } } oe_yp_end_YLY = yes }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { AND = { country_exists = c:YGU c:YGU = { this = root } } } } oe_yp_end_YGU = yes }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:YHN c:YHN = { this = root } } oe_yp_end_YHN = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { country_exists = c:YJZ c:YJZ = { this = root } } oe_yp_end_YJZ = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { country_exists = c:YJX c:YJX = { this = root } } oe_yp_end_YJX = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { country_exists = c:YHG c:YHG = { this = root } } oe_yp_end_YHG = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { country_exists = c:YSX c:YSX = { this = root } } oe_yp_end_YSX = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { country_exists = c:YSC c:YSC = { this = root } } oe_yp_end_YSC = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { country_exists = c:YLB c:YLB = { this = root } } oe_yp_end_YLB = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { country_exists = c:YLY c:YLY = { this = root } } oe_yp_end_YLY = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { country_exists = c:YGU c:YGU = { this = root } } oe_yp_end_YGU = yes }
}

# Any scope; the monthly anchor (on_action oe_yp_collapse_pulse) or the dev button yclcheck. First the Yuan as a whole
# (oe_yp_yuan_fallen); while it stands, one unit at a time: the vanilla region losses (REGION_LOSS), a seat that left CHI's
# hands, a secretariat that no longer exists or is no longer CHI's subject.
oe_yp_collapse_check = {
    # the Yuan's own country object (it stays the same when vanilla turns it into YUA or re-forms CHI_f)
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yp_yuan } country_exists = c:CHI c:CHI = { culture = culture:mongolian_culture NOT = { has_variable = rtr_is_new_china } } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yp_yuan value = c:CHI }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yp_dissolved } oe_yp_yuan_fallen = yes }
        oe_yp_dissolve_all = { reason = oe_yp_fall_reason }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yp_dissolved } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yp_end_u9 } has_fired_unique_event = red_turban_rebellions.42 } oe_yp_end_unit_9 = { reason = 4 } } # vanilla red_turban_rebellions.42
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yp_loss_44 } has_fired_unique_event = red_turban_rebellions.44 } set_global_variable = oe_yp_loss_44 oe_y1_end_xuanzheng = yes } # vanilla red_turban_rebellions.44
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yp_end_u2 } NOT = { location:tongxu = { owner ?= c:CHI } } } oe_yp_end_unit_2 = { reason = 1 } } # 河南江北: seat lost
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yp_end_u2 } NOT = { country_exists = c:YHN } } oe_yp_end_unit_2 = { reason = 3 } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yp_end_u2 } country_exists = c:YHN c:YHN = { NOT = { is_subject_of = c:CHI } } } oe_yp_end_unit_2 = { reason = 2 } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yp_end_u3 } NOT = { location:hangzhou = { owner ?= c:CHI } } } oe_yp_end_unit_3 = { reason = 1 } } # 江浙: seat lost
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yp_end_u3 } NOT = { country_exists = c:YJZ } } oe_yp_end_unit_3 = { reason = 3 } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yp_end_u3 } country_exists = c:YJZ c:YJZ = { NOT = { is_subject_of = c:CHI } } } oe_yp_end_unit_3 = { reason = 2 } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yp_end_u4 } NOT = { location:nanchang = { owner ?= c:CHI } } } oe_yp_end_unit_4 = { reason = 1 } } # 江西: seat lost
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yp_end_u4 } NOT = { country_exists = c:YJX } } oe_yp_end_unit_4 = { reason = 3 } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yp_end_u4 } country_exists = c:YJX c:YJX = { NOT = { is_subject_of = c:CHI } } } oe_yp_end_unit_4 = { reason = 2 } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yp_end_u5 } NOT = { location:jiangxia = { owner ?= c:CHI } } } oe_yp_end_unit_5 = { reason = 1 } } # 湖广: seat lost
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yp_end_u5 } NOT = { country_exists = c:YHG } } oe_yp_end_unit_5 = { reason = 3 } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yp_end_u5 } country_exists = c:YHG c:YHG = { NOT = { is_subject_of = c:CHI } } } oe_yp_end_unit_5 = { reason = 2 } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yp_end_u6 } NOT = { location:xianning_xian = { owner ?= c:CHI } } } oe_yp_end_unit_6 = { reason = 1 } } # 陕西: seat lost
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yp_end_u6 } NOT = { country_exists = c:YSX } } oe_yp_end_unit_6 = { reason = 3 } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yp_end_u6 } country_exists = c:YSX c:YSX = { NOT = { is_subject_of = c:CHI } } } oe_yp_end_unit_6 = { reason = 2 } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yp_end_u7 } NOT = { location:chengdu = { owner ?= c:CHI } } } oe_yp_end_unit_7 = { reason = 1 } } # 四川: seat lost
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yp_end_u7 } NOT = { country_exists = c:YSC } } oe_yp_end_unit_7 = { reason = 3 } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yp_end_u7 } country_exists = c:YSC c:YSC = { NOT = { is_subject_of = c:CHI } } } oe_yp_end_unit_7 = { reason = 2 } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yp_end_u8 } NOT = { country_exists = c:YLB } } oe_yp_end_unit_8 = { reason = 3 } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yp_end_u8 } country_exists = c:YLB c:YLB = { NOT = { is_subject_of = c:CHI } } } oe_yp_end_unit_8 = { reason = 2 } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yp_end_u9 } NOT = { country_exists = c:YLY } } oe_yp_end_unit_9 = { reason = 3 } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yp_end_u9 } country_exists = c:YLY c:YLY = { NOT = { is_subject_of = c:CHI } } } oe_yp_end_unit_9 = { reason = 2 } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yp_end_u10 } NOT = { country_exists = c:YGU } } oe_yp_end_unit_10 = { reason = 3 } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yp_end_u10 } country_exists = c:YGU c:YGU = { NOT = { is_subject_of = c:CHI } } } oe_yp_end_unit_10 = { reason = 2 } }
    }
}

# Any scope. Redo the start setup now: unit variables (idempotent), then the countries' missing pieces.
oe_yp_dev_setup = {
    oe_yp_assign_units_now = yes
    oe_yp_setup_countries = yes
}

# Any scope. One monthly update of every branch secretariat now.
oe_yp_dev_monthly = {
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:CHI }
        c:CHI = { every_subject = { limit = { OR = { is_subject_type = oe_yp_xingsheng is_subject_type = oe_yp_frontier } } oe_yp_monthly = yes } }
    }
}
